items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin from PS. Sampson expected significant time, min 4 games.
items.why: Knee injury on kick return in W1; official IR move.
items.implication: Judkins clear lead; Sanders/McLaughlin committee backups.
items.opportunity: Judkins every-down upside rises; Sanders handcuff/waiver.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. Same left knee that had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year—scary history.
items.why: Coach/sources optimistic on quick return after procedure; Kubiak day-to-day.
items.implication: Potential TE1 back sooner than typical meniscus timeline; Mayer temporary starter.
items.opportunity: If active, immediate high target share.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, monitored throughout week; status up in the air vs Raiders.
items.why: Exited W1 with chest/rib after big hit; further testing, day-to-day per Harbaugh.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist, believed fractured) expected longer absence than Flowers; surgery possible, miss several weeks/IR candidate.
items.why: Fractured wrist confirmed via reports; further testing/surgery.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; MRI but if playoff game likely returns. Day-to-day; coach Minter confirms.
items.why: Aggravated prior issue but sources downplay severity.
items.implication: Likely plays W2 or close; high upside if active.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week (FF Happy Hour).
items.why: Highlighted on FFHH as add amid injury/role situations.
items.implication: Priority waiver in deeper leagues for upside.

items.text: ETR W2 early injury report beneficiaries (available): McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Raheim Sanders; plus others like Brown, etc. Streamers and FAAB guidance live.
items.why: Precise injury-linked adds with FAAB/drop lists.
items.implication: Priority claims on listed beneficiaries and streamers (Wentz etc).

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9 (2.5 in MNF); needs serious volume. Just 2 targets (7% share) but routes elite: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present but low aDOT and target share limit box-score upside without volume spike.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor target share expansion.
items.opportunity: High route participation already; needs more targets.

items.text: Kenneth Walker was a true workhorse in KC debut: handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving share as expected in new offense.
items.implication: High-end RB1 usage locked in immediately.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty UPGRADES to high-end RB1: 99 Util Score (tied Bijan), 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes/21% targets, 23 att +6 tgt, 156 yds, 2 rec TDs.
items.why: Dominant every-down role and efficiency in new scheme/OL.
items.implication: RB1 locked; history of high rush+target share backs it.

items.text: Bucky Irving W1 result (22.3 PPR) overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7/7 targets. But sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked healthy. Good CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line and route edge over Gainwell; healthy.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 with upside if volume grows.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/Etienne, 26 Miller, 15 Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Committee even without Kamara; Miller got meaningful work.
items.implication: Etienne low-end RB2; Kamara return further clouds.
items.conflict: Expected lead role not fully realized.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since 9/28/25 ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Encouraging snap/route/target share immediately post-major knee surgery.
items.implication: WR1 trajectory intact if health holds; ramp-up possible.
items.opportunity: High target share and routes on limited snaps.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used 3rd-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low receiving involvement despite backup injury.
items.implication: More pure rusher; limited PPR ceiling currently.
items.opportunity: IR of Sampson may force more work but routes lagged.
